title: Novice Trade: SQ
text:
Mark Sebastian | Sep 6, 2018 | 3:00 PM EDT
Yesterday's shell shacking of the payment space provides a nice opportunity to step in and go long. The price action on the stocks is super bullish. The NDX is getting punched in the face...again.
In addition, the NDX sell-off is being led by the sexy names in investing, the "FANG" names and Apple (AAPL) . Thus the fact that this sector is being bought on a really rough day is super compelling. I can buy the Sep14 90 calls for about 2.00 in Square (SQ) .
